refinement.detail: SEARCHED, FOUND NONE, AND FINDING ONE WOULD HAVE BEEN OUT OF ROLE. RM-05 is `role: evaluation`: it MEASURES and FIXES NOTHING, and it added no production line, no adapter, no TLA+ action and no test. Its whole delta is evidence under `specs/results/scorecards/portable-substrate/RM-05/`, five findings appended to `deferred_findings.yaml`, a section prepended to `NEXT-EPIC.md`, and the ticket plan's RM-05 status. A refinement search was nonetheless run over the surfaces this round measured, and what it found are REFINEMENTS FOR SOMEBODY ELSE TO APPLY, which is why the outcome here is `none` rather than `found`. They are recorded as `suggested_fix` on RM-05-DF-01..05 and in RESULT.md section 9.2, and the largest are: give `entail` a verdict meaning EXTINCT and exclude declared controls from its verdict table (RM-05-DF-01); make `SUPPORTED_VERSIONS` something a stranger can extend (section 9.2 item 1); declare the version-4 era boundary in INSTRUMENT-LOG.toml and key the judge tier on the full model id (RM-05-DF-03). Applying any of them inside a measurement is the move `measurement_rule` forbids.

behavior_tests.evidence: specs/results/scorecards/portable-substrate/RM-05/suite-fe87dfb-row3.txt -- 2 failed, 1473 passed at fe87dfb in a real checkout, quiescent. RECORDED AS `fail` RATHER THAN EXPLAINED AWAY. One failure is RM-06-DF-01's deliberate same-tag control, inherited and untouched. The second is this ticket's own: `test_nothing_in_the_repository_invokes_the_pricer` refuses a prose MENTION of `price_removal` outside `specs/`, and the NEXT-EPIC.md this work order mandates names the file. The available repair is the test's own allow-list; taking it would be editing a target so a result passes, which an evaluation may not do. RESULT.md section 8.1.

descriptor_comparison.evidence: No descriptor comparison is meaningful for this ticket and saying so is the honest entry: RM-05 changes no Python, so `scripts/` and `examples/validation/` are byte-identical before and after it. The before/after this round DID record is a different quantity and it is in RESULT.md section 1.1 -- the served rubric at 19c5c7b and at 58411dc, 8,396 bytes and 25 anchor rungs against 6,409 and 9, which is the surface this epic actually moved.

ticket.objective: The epic's product and a MEASUREMENT. THE HEADLINE IS WHETHER THE SUBSTRATE GOT SIMPLER IN A WAY THAT CAN BE DEMONSTRATED RATHER THAN ASSERTED -- lines, instruments, AND concepts an adopter must understand. subtract-to-measure called itself a simplification at net +1677 lines. Decide all four goals. Report FINDINGS BY CHANNEL with the per-token ratio AND NAME THE TOKEN BASIS -- no previous round has, so no round has ever been comparable to another (RD-03-DF-13). And report THE COUNT OF FINDINGS TOUCHING THE SHIPPED TOOLCHAIN, stated SEPARATELY from findings about generated artifacts: across four epics that number is 8 OF 134 and last epic it was ZERO, and conflating the two is how a flattering headline got merged. FILE FINDINGS, FIX NOTHING.
